title: Scammer videsh me... par WhatsApp Indian number se kaise?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [curious] Scammer videsh me... par WhatsApp call Indian number se!
Kaise? Indian SIM pe ek baar OTP...
WhatsApp chalu, SIM phenko... app chalta rehta!
Ek January se naya rule: SIM binding.
Phone me wo SIM nahi? Toh WhatsApp BAND!
Aise aur raaz ke liye... follow karo!
caption:
Scammer videsh me baitha hai... par WhatsApp call aata hai Indian number se! 📱 Ye kaise hota hai?

Jugaad:
• WhatsApp tumhara number sirf ek baar OTP se check karta hai. Uske baad SIM nikaal do ya band ho jaaye, app aam taur pe chalta rehta hai.
• DoT ne Supreme Court ko bataya: scammers kisi Indian SIM pe OTP mangwa ke videsh se WhatsApp chalate hain. 'Digital arrest' jaise scam me aksar yahi jugaad hota hai (digital arrest cases: 2022 me 39,925, 2024 me 1,23,672).

Naya rule: SIM binding
• WhatsApp, Telegram jaise apps ko 31 December 2026 tak SIM binding laagu karni hai, 1 January 2027 se chalu.
• Jis number pe account hai, wo SIM phone me active honi chahiye. SIM nikali, badli ya band hui, toh app tab tak nahi chalega jab tak sahi SIM wapas na daalo.

Tip: jis number pe tumhara WhatsApp hai, wo SIM usi phone me rakho aur recharge chalu rakho.

Tumhara WhatsApp kis number pe hai, phone wale SIM pe ya purane pe? Comment karo 👇
